shots.detail_en: Pre-dawn back room of a 90s tea restaurant turned war room; close-up of Lu Changhong's hand pinning a red thread onto a wall covered with hand-drawn giant candlestick charts, the thread running across the whole wall
shots.sub: 旁白（长虹）：「熊天成说，十年最大的熊市，明早开演。」
shots.speaker: NARRATOR

shots.detail_en: Night street corner; a TV-interview poster of Xiong Tiancheng being pasted on a utility pole, bold characters reading THE BIGGEST BEAR MARKET IN TEN YEARS
Wang Mancang in a loud flower shirt bursts in with a hemp sack, pouring hundreds of beeper pagers across the table
shots.sub: 满仓：「三千台！全厅散户的BP机，我一晚上全租来了——全租！这叫满仓式租赁！」
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Shen Hongli slams a stack of trade confirmation receipts on the table, fingertip sliding down a column of numbers
shots.sub: 红利：「联华网络三天对倒量翻了四倍。左边口袋卖，右边口袋买——他在自己演给自己看。」
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Changhong pins the other end of the red thread onto the hand-written words LIANHUA NETWORK on the wall
shots.sub: 长虹：「这根阴线不是刀，是他撒的网。他先吓，再收。十年前，我父亲就是被这张网收走的鱼。」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Mancang shivers while rubbing a pager, looking to Changhong
shots.sub: 满仓：「那……那我们？拆网？」长虹：「不。我们做网眼里最硬的蚂蚁——他一收，我们就搬家。」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Opening bell; the huge flip-board screen turns a wall of green, green light washing over a sea of thousands of panicked retail faces
shots.sub: 散户群：「熊爷上电视说的……真砸下来了！」
shots.speaker: CROWD

shots.detail_en: Three rapid cuts: an old investor squatting head-in-hands / hands fighting over sell-order slips / a long queue snaking from the order window
shots.sub: 旁白：「十年前的这一幕，我在天台下面看过一次。」
shots.speaker: NARRATOR

shots.detail_en: EXPLOSIVE BEAT: Changhong climbs onto a trading desk while Mancang slams the pager master broadcast key; thousands of pagers beep in unison across the hall
shots.sub: 长虹：「各位！他喊得越凶的那只票，就是他最想吃的那碗饭——割肉单，全部给我停！」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Hongli holds a confirmation receipt high, her arm sweeping across the crowd
shots.sub: 红利：「账不会说谎！昨天每一张割肉单，都被喊空的人自己吃走了——卖出的是你，买进的是他！」
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: A hand pulls its sell order back from the window, then more and more hands follow
shots.sub: 散户甲：「不卖了！」满仓：「不卖！咱是蚂蚁，蚂蚁不搬家先踩死自己人！」
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Montage: sell orders withdrawn one by one / the green wave on the board narrowing / the crowd rising from crouch to stand
shots.sub: 旁白：「蚂蚁搬不动山。蚂蚁只需要——不自己先跑。」
shots.speaker: NARRATOR

shots.detail_en: On the big screen the tall green candle of Lianhua Network shrinks into one thin needle and holds
shots.sub: 长虹（低语）：「第一针，止住血了。」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: VIP mezzanine; Xiong Wei closes his laptop, the green board reflected in his rimless glasses
shots.sub: 熊伟：「爸，不是散户。三千个账户，同一个节拍——它们在听同一声哨。」
shots.speaker: XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: Xiong Wei's screen: from a sea of account data a cluster of synchronized accounts pops out, red circles locking one by one
shots.sub: 熊伟：「样本量够了。三天，我给你蚁后的名字。」
shots.speaker: XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: Lianhua Tower office; Xiong Tiancheng looks down through floor-to-ceiling glass at the hall crowd, Changhong's figure at its center
shots.sub: 熊：「急什么。我从来没有做错过任何事——这次也一样。」熊伟：「这次你在错。」熊：「那就让它，错得像一次成功。」
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: Market close; Mancang sprawls in a chair, stacking pagers into a small mountain
shots.sub: 满仓：「三千台BP机，三千个不卖！兄弟们，蚂蚁第一天，搬动了熊爷一座山头！」
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: The hall empties after close; Changhong stands alone before the board staring at the needle-shaped green candle
shots.sub: 长虹：「喊一次不够的。他这个人，从不见好就收。」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: The huge screen suddenly cuts to black; the hall PA blasts the suspension announcement; the whole crowd gasps
shots.sub: 广播：「联华网络，临时停牌，重大事项待公告。」
shots.speaker: PA

shots.detail_en: Hongli, face pale, grabs Changhong's sleeve, confirmation slips scattering across the floor
shots.sub: 红利：「停牌前最后一笔大卖单，是他自己的账户砸的——他要掀桌子重洗！」长虹：「不。他是在给我递请柬。」
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Slow-motion close-up of Changhong's pocket-watch chain: the watch that runs one minute slow, its second hand ticking to a stop before the red suspension notice
Black screen next-episode card with white bold text
shots.sub: 字幕：「牌桌对面，坐着谁？」
